claims.claim: the null control is expressible as a rule applied to a committed ref, and the ref a row carries names the manifest, the rule and the base — so it resolves without the argv that made the run (RB-P17)
claims.note: The filing proposed derive:<label>:<rule-id>. L1 confirmed it resolves only from the argv that defined the base label and names the manifest nowhere — a pointer into a process that has exited, which is the same failure as a pointer into a cleaned directory, one indirection along. The mutation ships exactly that form; the fresh-run resolver, which has only the repo, cannot expand `A-asfiled` and the node goes red. The derived variant reproduces the frozen manifest's committed base_sha256 for B-nonewline (d1f32ad2947b...), so this is the acceptance pair and not an invented one.
